five_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER backfill_plan_units_immutable_v2 BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_plan_units_v2 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_evidence_guard_v2()
CREATE TRIGGER backfill_run_immutable_v2 BEFORE UPDATE ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_run_guard_v2()
CREATE TRIGGER backfill_static_plan_snapshot_v2 AFTER INSERT ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_snapshot_insert_v2()
CREATE TRIGGER backfill_task_scope_v2 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_task_guard_v2()

CREATE TRIGGER backfill_plan_manifest_immutable_v2 BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_plan_manifests_v2 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_evidence_guard_v2()

guarantees_and_limits: Origin-enabled task-scope trigger rejects any UPDATE change to id/run_id/family/provider/kind/scope/dependencies. There is no scope-change exception in the current function.
The active-run/current-fence insertion check is only on INSERT; it is not repeated by the task trigger for UPDATE. Normal RPC ownership and current-run checks remain necessary.
The task trigger does not itself prohibit DELETE or TRUNCATE, freeze every mutable field, or make run metadata immutable. Do not infer these stronger guarantees.

Ordinary INSERT in an origin session executes the existing snapshot helper in the inserting transaction; an exception rolls back the insertion and helper effects. A false helper return is legitimate for dynamic exclusions or any existing global unit.
The snapshot trigger does not guarantee every task has a plan unit: dynamic tasks are excluded and historical trigger state is not established by this current receipt.
Plan-unit and manifest statement triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. They do not restrict INSERT to the target task run or independently prove task/unit run equality.
The observed replication role is the diagnostic session. O-enabled triggers are not an ALWAYS trigger; this receipt does not establish historical operation or every separate future session setting.

The current run guard preserves fixed scope, monotonically increasing listed counters/fence and terminal stop. It permits metadata updates, so the new cursor must enforce its own shape/binding and advancement invariants.
Preserve unchanged final missing-snapshot, count/hash, coverage and representative-map checks for all unproved or later-inserted cases.
insert_exemption_limits: An absent or empty member_ids array is permitted for these cases.
When member_ids is present it must still be an array of at most 3000 fixed-run member IDs. JSON null is not an absent value.
The existing retained_identity and retained_massive_archive specific checks remain exact.
